conventions.convention: The geometry has signature (−,+,+,+), an independent orientation, and a positively oriented chart. The tangent-bundle background assumes Countable Choice ACω.

K=[t₀,t₁]×Ω, with t₀<t₁ and Ω a product of three nonempty open bounded intervals. Its compact closure lies inside the chart image. The metric is smooth; the spatial block h is positive definite and g⁰⁰<0 near the closure. Currents are C¹ on an open neighborhood of the closure.
α=(−g⁰⁰)^(−1/2), nᵃ=−αgᵃ⁰, and nₐ=−αδₐ⁰; this unit slice normal is assumed future-directed. Slice orientation puts n before a positive slice basis. Signed charge is Q_J(t)=∫Ω −g(J,n)√det(h) d³x.

Net outward side flux is the sum of upper-minus-lower wJⁱ face integrals over the remaining three coordinates, including the time interval. Flux uses contraction with the oriented metric volume form and requires no side-face unit normal, including on null faces.

Integrals are Riemann integrals over bounded Jordan sets, defined by zero extension to a containing nondegenerate rectangle. Coordinates have no assigned physical units, and current charge carries no adopted entropy or conservation interpretation.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the positively oriented finite product slab with compact closure, spacelike slices, future unit normal, C¹ current near the closure, signed normal slice charge, and upper-minus-lower net outward side flux, using bounded-Jordan Riemann integrals.

Under ACω and the slab and C¹-current hypotheses of def-tgr-spacelike-current-slab, with Π=∇ₐJᵃ, Q_J(t₁)−Q_J(t₀)+Φ_J(B)=∫K Π vol_g. If Π≥0 on K, then Q_J(t₁)+Φ_J(B)≥Q_J(t₀); zero net side flux implies nondecreasing endpoint charge. If Π=0, the charge change equals −Φ_J(B), so zero production alone does not imply constant charge.

For m≥1 and finite endpoints a_j<b_j, the closed product box Q is compact and Jordan measurable with content-zero boundary. Every stated open, closed or half-open endpoint variant R is a bounded Jordan set, and every continuous real function on Q is integrable over R. For m≥2 the analogous conclusions hold for coordinate faces in their own (m−1)-dimensional coordinate spaces.
Under ACω, for a time-oriented smooth Lorentzian four-manifold with its metric-selected connection, a smooth chart, w=√|det(g_ab)| and a C¹ vector field J on the chart domain, ∇ₐJᵃ=w⁻¹∂ₐ(wJᵃ).
Assume ACω and the spacelike slab data of def-tgr-spacelike-current-slab. For every slice and every C¹ current in that definition, Q_J(t)=∫Ω wJ⁰ d³x.

seams_checked.note: Checked the supplier definitions and balance against lem-tgr-killing-energy-normalization Statement, L1–L2 and steps 3.1–4.1, and cor-tgr-killing-no-work-support Statement, L1–L2 and steps 3.1–4.1.
